title: Storage Layout Isolation & Preservation (Proxy / Delegatecall / Upgrade)

swc: SWC-124 Write to Arbitrary Storage Location
cwe: CWE-668 Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere

dascp.note: Layout preservation under proxy/delegatecall/upgrade is one necessary condition for safe feature deployment; does not establish the broader deployment-process control.

iof.note: Storage-layout isolation and append-only preservation across upgrades is the on-chain mechanism that lets a long-lived security or contract upgrade without distorting flows or breaking transferability across versions; cross-chain version negotiation and the harmonised version-record schema stay out-of-scope as data-harmonisation concerns.

Layout-preserving upgrade covers the governed-upgrade facet of token/contract-structure standardisation; chain-agnostic interface definitions, verifiable contract provenance, audited-code attestation, and explicit pause/kill semantics stay out-of-scope as data-standardisation and operational concerns.

descriptions.semantic: Each logical state variable of a contract (and of every implementation reachable by delegatecall) maps to a stable, non-overlapping storage slot. No write through one logical name can alias the slot of another, no proxy/implementation pair shares a slot it does not intend to, and no upgrade relocates an existing variable. Layout is collision-free at any instant and preserved (append-only) across upgrades.
descriptions.system_theoretic: An injectivity-and-stability constraint on the slot-assignment function σ: Var → Slot. Collision-freedom is injectivity of σ; isolation across delegatecall is disjointness of the proxy's and implementation's private footprints; preservation is a refinement relation σ_v ⊑ σ_{v'} between successive layouts that keeps every previously-assigned slot fixed.
descriptions.security: A violated slot mapping is an arbitrary-storage-write primitive: an attacker (or an innocent struct reordering) can overwrite the admin slot, the implementation pointer, a balance, a role set, or a reentrancy lock — silently, without invoking the function that nominally owns that data. It is the substrate beneath proxy takeover and uninitialized-proxy bricking.
descriptions.execution_semantics: EVM storage is a flat 2^256 keyword-addressed map; Solidity assigns slots by declaration order (sequential) or by hashed namespace (ERC-7201) / struct pointer (diamond). Collisions arise from: declaration-order drift between proxy and implementation, struct field reordering on upgrade, hash-namespace coincidence (negligible if derived correctly), and direct assembly sstore. Delegatecall executes implementation code against the proxy's storage, so both must agree on σ for shared variables and be disjoint elsewhere.
descriptions.formal_verification: A safety property reducible to SMT/dataflow: prove σ injective over declared variables and disjoint across the delegatecall pair, and prove the upgrade diff is a layout-preserving extension. Separation logic gives the cleanest proof structure (disjoint heap footprints).

formalization.signature: Var the set of logical variables; Slot = {0..2^256-1}; σ: Var → Slot the layout. For a proxy P and implementation I sharing storage via delegatecall: σ_P, σ_I.
formalization.first_order_logic:
Collision-freedom:  ∀ v,w ∈ Var . v ≠ w → σ(v) ≠ σ(w).
Delegatecall isolation:  (∀ v ∈ Shared . σ_P(v) = σ_I(v))  ∧  (∀ v ∈ Priv_P, w ∈ Priv_I . σ_P(v) ≠ σ_I(w)).
Upgrade preservation (impl version n → n+1):  ∀ v ∈ dom(σ_n) . σ_{n+1}(v) = σ_n(v)   (append-only).

temporal_logic.ltl: G( ∀ slot . writes-to(slot) originate only from the unique variable v with σ(v)=slot )

hoare.post: only Shared ∪ Priv_I slots intended by f are mutated; Priv_P untouched

formalization.state_machine: Model storage as a heap; each function's footprint is a slot set. The property is the frame condition that distinct logical regions have disjoint footprints across the full call composition.
formalization.type_theoretic: Separation logic: storage isolation is the assertion `proxyState * implState * sharedState` where `*` enforces disjointness; a write respecting σ preserves the separating conjunction. ERC-7201 realizes this by typing each module's storage as a distinct named region rooted at keccak256(namespace)−1 masked to a 256-aligned base.
formalization.algebraic: σ is a partial injection Var ↪ Slot; the upgrade order forms a refinement poset under ⊑ = graph-inclusion; well-formed upgrades are monotone in this poset.

relationships.note: Access control assumes its role/admin slots are not aliasable; isolation discharges that.
The reentrancy mutex's integrity depends on its slot not being collidable.

attack_surface.pattern: proxy and implementation declare variables in incompatible order; an implementation write lands on the proxy admin/impl slot
attack_surface.notes: EIP-1967 fixes the admin/impl/beacon slots at pseudo-random constants to avoid this.

attack_surface.pattern: implementation left uninitialized; attacker initializes, becomes owner, and can selfdestruct or upgrade
incident_refs: Parity multisig wallet freeze (2017) — VERIFIED historical incident (uninitialized library + selfdestruct)

attack_surface.pattern: reordering or inserting a field in a storage struct shifts every subsequent variable's slot
attack_surface.notes: Append-only discipline + automated layout diff prevents this.

attack_surface.pattern: two facets/modules derive overlapping storage bases
attack_surface.notes: Maps directly to the storage-slot-collision error class raised by diamond/modular-kernel storage validators; ERC-7201 namespacing is the mitigation.

metrics: layout-diff delta between successive implementations (should be append-only)
invariant_checkpoints: EIP-1967 admin/impl slots hold expected values

strategies.notes: Detects non-append-only layout changes and proxy/impl mismatch.
Proves no write reaches a foreign slot across delegatecall — the only level that catches assembly sstore.

tools: diamond/modular-kernel storage validators (slot-collision and selector-clash checks)
strategies.notes: Rejects an install/upgrade that would collide.

testability: fuzz: write each variable, assert no other variable observes the write

static: automated layout diff in CI gating upgrades

assumptions.statement: Compiler assigns slots deterministically and as documented (declaration order / namespace formula).

provenance.notes: Primary discharge target for BPO:0001/0020 storage assumptions and a natural integration anchor for diamond/modular upgradeable frameworks (ERC-7201 / slot-collision checks).
